sources.title: TTT-VLA: Test-Time Latent Prompt Optimization for Vision-Language ...
sources.snippet: TTT-VLA, a deployment-time improvement framework for VLA based on Latent Prompt Optimization, which learns a latent prompt during training and performs prompt-only test-time training on a frozen policy at deployment time.

sources.title: TTT-VLA: Test-Time Latent Prompt Optimization for Vision-Language ...
sources.snippet: We address this question with TTT-VLA, a test-time training framework based on Latent Prompt Optimization (LPO). During training, the latent prompt is learned with an additional proxy task, providing an extra learned conditioning signal for policy learning.

sources.title: Multi-Layer Perceptron Learning - GeeksforGeeks
sources.snippet: A Multi-Layer Perceptron (MLP) is a type of artificial neural network that learns patterns and relationships from data to make predictions. Consists of an input layer, one or more hidden layers and an output layer, with neurons connected through learnable weights and biases. Commonly used for classification and regression tasks.
